en.hubeali: H 14750 – Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammaad, from Yahya Bin Al-Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin Jabalat, from Is’haq Bin Ammaar, who said: Abu Abdullahasws has said:
‘The one who repairs his owns shoes, and stitches his own clothes, and carries his own commodities is free from the arrogance’.
en.sarwar: 302. Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammaad, from Yahya Bin Al-Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin Jabalat, from Is’haq Bin Ammaar, who said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said:
‘The one who repairs his owns shoes, and stitches his own clothes, and carries his own commodities is free from the arrogance’.
